decisions.reason: Although this yogurt fit the firm's dairy know-how and had early award-based validation, two years without website visibility in a narrow organic range suggest it is not important enough to keep allocating shelf space and learning effort to.

This cheese variant strongly matches the firm's core competence and was initially a focus product, but its later disappearance from communication indicates weaker lasting traction than first expected and makes resource reallocation slightly more likely than continuation.
The semi-hard cheese wheel is close to existing cheese capabilities, yet its low distinctiveness and lack of later market visibility make it a likely candidate for portfolio pruning.

A spicy cheese line offers some scope for learning within the firm's knowledge base, but if even a multi-model line is no longer visible after launch, management would likely consolidate around stronger core cheese products.
This mild creamy soft cheese is technically well within the firm's absorptive capacity, but as a complementary extension with no later presence it looks too peripheral to justify continued support.
Washed-rind soft cheese is related to the firm's cheese expertise but is more demanding in process control and market acceptance, so prolonged non-visibility makes withdrawal the most likely outcome.
